entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker, uncompleated after serving Phyrexia, who apologizes to Elspeth for trying to kill her but refuses to join her and Narset.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: An archangel and planeswalker with candle-flame glowing eyes who forgives Ajani and travels with Narset into the dragonstorms.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Waymaster of the Jeskai who leads Elspeth through the dragonstorms to a hidden temple and the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Felothar
aliases: the new khan of the Abzan
entities.description: The soldierly Abzan khan, who rules with her Council of Houses and decides to prepare Arashin's defenses.

entities.name: Nur
entities.description: The Abzan djinni who arrives to back up Ajani's report of Sarkhan's dragons.

entities.name: Beyza
entities.description: A scarred djinni of House Zanhar, the House of Grit, who doubts Narset's warning and is teased by Nur.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who threw off compleation and appears in the Meditation Realm with Loot, claiming to be fixing his mistakes.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A young, golden-furred, sleeping creature held in a blue light, whose mind contains a map of the Multiverse and every Omenpath.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who commands wild dragons, with hundreds of dragons already in his army.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A woman of unique resistance to phyresis who saved Ajani and died.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian praetor to whom Ajani wanted to offer Elspeth's corpse.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A friend who Narset notes was compleated.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The Jeskai dragonlord whose archives Narset studied.

entities.name: Arashin
entities.description: The Abzan city whose fortifications are being raised for the dragon threat.

entities.name: Stormplains
entities.description: Plains of Tarkir where the dragonstorms warp the land and from which Narset and Elspeth enter the storm.

entities.name: Temple in the heart of the storms
entities.description: An ancient, massive temple at the foot of which Narset and Elspeth emerge; its architecture is unknown even to Ojutai's records.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A ragged, ancient portal in the temple's antechamber that leads to the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: A mirrored, shifting realm of endless water and stairs where Narset has been before, appearing different to each viewer and meant to conceal something.

entities.name: Council of Houses
entities.description: The Abzan council of house heads advising the khan.

entities.name: House Emesh
entities.description: An Abzan house whose old representative wants active defenses.

entities.name: House Gudal
entities.description: An Abzan house whose appointed leader trusts the walls.

entities.name: House Zanhar
entities.description: An ancient Abzan house of djinn represented by Beyza.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: The clan sheltering in Arashin and preparing for dragons.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: The clan led by Narset.

entities.name: Dragonstorms
entities.description: Storms that create more wild dragons and warp the land with scales.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane whose phyresis compleated Ajani and Jace.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes that Elspeth has seen.

events.summary: Ajani asks Felothar to release Narset and Elspeth without waiting for consensus so they can try to quell the dragonstorms.
events.quote: they need to go on their way to see if there is a way to quell the dragonstorms.

events.summary: Felothar frees the three and announces evacuation and fortification of Arashin.
events.quote: You three are free to go.

events.summary: Narset warns that Sarkhan could bring thousands of dragons against Arashin, and the council doubts her.
events.quote: It will be thousands of dragons.

events.summary: Nur arrives and confirms that hundreds of dragons are already in Sarkhan's army.
events.quote: My scouts report there are already hundreds of dragons in Sarkhan's army.

events.summary: Felothar declares the Abzan will focus on preparation and dismisses the visitors, providing them with supplies.
events.quote: You will be provisioned with whatever you might need.

events.summary: Ajani confesses to Elspeth that he joined Phyrexia willingly and apologizes for trying to kill her.
events.quote: I was not forced. I was not compelled. I did it willingly.

events.summary: Elspeth tells Ajani he was forgiven before their fight began, and Narset invites him to help stop the dragonstorms.
events.quote: You were forgiven before our fight even began.

events.summary: Ajani refuses to join them and walks away.
events.quote: And he was gone before Elspeth or Narset could say another word

events.summary: Narset and Elspeth step into the dragonstorm, shielded by blue light, and walk toward a bright light amid forming dragons.
events.quote: Narset stepped into the storm and Elspeth followed.

events.summary: The storm falls silent and they find a massive ancient temple that Narset does not recognize from any records.
participants: Temple in the heart of the storms
events.location: Temple in the heart of the storms
events.quote: There is a temple in the heart of the storms,

events.summary: Narset and Elspeth find an Omenpath in a subterranean antechamber and step through.
events.location: Temple in the heart of the storms
events.quote: Nothing to do but step through, then,

events.summary: Elspeth sees endless water while Narset sees stairs, and they realize this Meditation Realm is a distraction hiding something.
events.quote: The Meditation Realm. I've been here before.

events.summary: Narset hears a weeping voice whispering a name, and Jace Beleren appears.
events.quote: Jace Beleren stood on a rime of white sand

events.summary: Jace reveals he escaped compleation by force of will, and Narset theorizes how.
events.quote: I was on my way to that, yes. But I am not anymore.

events.summary: Jace introduces Loot, a creature whose mind holds a map of every Omenpath, and Narset questions whether Loot consented to this state.
events.quote: He is a map of everything .

events.summary: Jace evades Elspeth's question, saying he did what he needed to.

relations.quote: without Loot, I'd have never found my way here.
